hooks.command: echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Worktree creation disabled — work directly in main directory"}'
TURNS=$(cat | jq 'try (.transcript | length) catch 0' 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && [ "${TURNS:-0}" -gt 5 ] && echo '📝 Meaningful session detected. Run /log-session if worth keeping.' || true
echo '=== grill-me skill loaded ===' && cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md" 2>/dev/null || true

echo '=== Theme map loaded ===' && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/Vault/Memory/theme-name-map.md" ] && echo 'Theme map available at Vault/Memory/theme-name-map.md' || echo 'Warning: Theme map not found'
echo '=== Memory index loaded ===' && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/Vault/Memory/MEMORY.md" ] && cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/Vault/Memory/MEMORY.md" || echo 'Warning: MEMORY.md not found'
